# The Supply Chain of Intelligence™

> A strategic framework by Anand Arivukkarasu mapping where AI value is created, captured, and defended across 10 layers and 50 sublayers. JTBD finds demand. The Supply Chain of Intelligence finds defensibility.

Built for SaaS founders, AI product leaders, and venture investors. The framework defines 10 layers (L-1 Resources, L0 Infrastructure, L1 Data, L2 Models, L3 Gatekeeping, L4 Access, L5 Execution, L6 Orchestration, L7 Surface, L8 Memory), 3 structural laws, the AI Defensibility Audit, and the Intelligence Cube™.

## Pages

- [Home](/): The thesis — JTBD vs the Supply Chain of Intelligence, the 10-layer stack, the Defensibility Audit.
- [Framework](/framework): Full breakdown of the 10 layers, 50 sublayers, and 3 structural laws.
- [Case Studies](/analysis): Structural analysis of Jasper, Chegg, Sierra, Harvey, Grammarly, Stack Overflow, Gamma, and others through the layer lens.
- [For Product Leaders](/for-product-leaders): How to add the Z-axis (depth in the stack) to JTBD-driven product thinking.

## Author

Anand Arivukkarasu — Ex-Meta and Ex-Google product leader. An Ideas2IT initiative.
